name: HELMET
description: HELMET is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate long-context language models across seven diverse, application-centric categories. It addresses limitations of previous benchmarks by supporting controllable context lengths up to 128K tokens, using model-based evaluation metrics, and few-shot prompting to robustly assess base models.
reputation: A newly introduced long-context benchmark that is intended to be comprehensive, but it has not yet had time to become widely established.
notes: Supports very long context lengths (up to 128K tokens) and includes diverse application-centric categories; uses model-based evaluation and few-shot prompting.
